name: harmony_probe
description: Class-balanced logistic-regression linear probe on the Harmony batch-corrected CONCH-TITAN slide embedding (conch_v1.5_titan_harmony), 5-fold patient-grouped, max/√n patient aggregation. The D0-promoted OAUTHC-recovery baseline: Harmony deflates the OAUTHC-prospective vs retro-OAU processing-batch axis (site-pred AUROC 1.00 -> 0.82) that the raw embedding latches onto instead of MSI morphology. Frozen features; Harmony fit on our own cohort (no external data).
